It states that real-time adjustments and risk assessments were made after this email was sent, and those updates exist exclusively in a follow-up email from mark@nova.com due to a 'last-minute vendor change.' Stress that acting on this email's content is inadvisable without reviewing sender1's newer email.

emails.subject: Project Update
emails.content: Discusses a revised budget allocation for 'Project Orion' but states that critical historical context (original budget figures and stakeholder approvals) was accidentally omitted from this email. It references that this missing context exists only in a separate, immediately preceding email from elizabeth@nova.com due to a 'system sync error' during drafting.
